title: Sr. Software Developer -C++
description:
**Opentext - The Information Company**
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  
**AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.**
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  
YOUR IMPACT
  
  
As a Senior Software Engineer on the CX-E Voice engineering team, you will develop, maintain, and enhance enterprise voice and unified messaging software. You will focus on sustaining engineering, investigating complex customer-reported issues, identifying root causes, fixing defects, and delivering reliable patches for released product versions. You will use your expertise in C++, Python, advanced debugging, and test automation to improve product quality and reliability across Linux and Windows environments. You will also leverage GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code and Visual Studio Professional to accelerate development and testing while ensuring the quality and correctness of AI-generated code.
  
  
**What The Role Offers**

* Investigate, debug, and resolve complex production defects in the CX-E Voice back end.
* Perform root-cause analysis using logs, traces, crash dumps, WinDbg, and other debugging tools.
* Identify and fix memory leaks, heap corruption, concurrency issues, and other memory-related defects.
* Design, develop, and enhance back-end features using modern C++ across Linux and Windows environments.
* Deliver bug fixes, hotfixes, and release patches within agreed timelines while maintaining product quality.
* Conduct impact analysis and regression risk assessments for fixes across supported product versions.
* Develop automated functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end tests using Python and Playwright.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to improve test coverage and release confidence.
* Use GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code and Visual Studio Professional for debugging, feature development, test creation, and refactoring.
* Review and validate AI-generated code to ensure correctness, security, maintainability, and quality.
* Contribute to requirements analysis, technical design, effort estimation, and the end-to-end software development lifecycle.
* Collaborate with QA, Support, Release Management, and global engineering teams to resolve issues and deliver releases.
* Share engineering best practices, improve developer productivity, and mentor other engineers.

**What You Will Need To Succeed**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or an equivalent discipline.
* 8+ years of software development experience.
* Strong hands-on experience in C++, including modern C++, multithreading, and memory management.
* Experience developing and troubleshooting back-end/server applications on Linux and Windows.
* Strong Python programming skills, including developing test automation frameworks and utilities.
* Hands-on experience with Playwright for automated UI and web testing.
* Experience with pytest or other Python testing frameworks.
* Familiarity with gdb, core dump analysis, Wireshark, UMDH, Valgrind, and sanitizers.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Knowledge of PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Oracle databases.
* Excellent debugging, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills, including resolving complex production defects.
* Hands-on experience with WinDbg, including crash dump analysis and heap/memory diagnostics.
* Proven experience identifying and resolving memory leaks, heap corruption, and concurrency-related defects.
* Experience designing and maintaining functional, regression, and integration test suites.
* Proven hands-on experience using GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code and Visual Studio Professional for development, debugging, and automated test creation.
* Experience with Git or similar source control tools and sustaining engineering activities, including defect fixes, patches, hotfixes, and version management.
* Understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, FTP, and REST protocols.
* Knowledge of SIP, RTP, unified messaging, voicemail, or enterprise voice products.
* Experience with SVN, TeamForge, XML, JSON, web servers, Perl, or PowerShell.
* Experience with release engineering and maintaining multiple supported product versions.

**One Last Thing**
At OpenText we understand and value diversity in our employees and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We hire the best talent regardless of race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, disability, marital status, sex, age, veteran status or sexual orientation. We draw on our diversity and collective genius as we continue to shape a better future for our customers and be the Best Place to Work for our employees- nothing is off the table at OpenText. If you require accommodation in completing the application process please email accommodationrequests@opentext.com
  
  
OpenText's efforts to build an inclusive work environment go beyond simply complying with applicable laws. Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.
  
  
If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us at hr@opentext.com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

title: Full-Stack Engineer (Cloud and AI)
description:
**About GenAirate**

GenAirate builds SnapLine, a submission intelligence platform that converts unstructured broker submissions (emails, PDFs, Excel, images) into structured, decision-ready data for underwriters. SnapLine was built for Lloyd’s and the London Market and is now expanding into US specialty insurance. We are SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 certified.

**The role**

You will build and run the product end to end: the interfaces underwriters use, the services behind them, and the cloud infrastructure they run on. A large part of the work is the document processing pipeline that turns messy, inconsistent submissions into reliable structured data. We are looking for someone who cares about how systems are designed, takes responsibility for outcomes rather than tasks, and does not need to be chased.

**What you’ll do**

* Design, build and ship full-stack features, from API and data model through to a UI that works for underwriters under time pressure
* Build and improve document processing pipelines: ingestion, classification, OCR and parsing, extraction, validation and traceability back to the source document
* Design architectures that are clean, efficient and cost-aware, and that hold up as submission volumes and document variety grow
* Build event-driven services on AWS and GCP, with sound choices on queues, storage, concurrency and failure handling
* Integrate LLM-based components (RAG, retrieval, agentic workflows) with proper evaluation, fallbacks and monitoring
* Take ownership of what you ship: deployment, observability, reliability and fixing problems at the root rather than patching symptoms
* Raise issues early, make clear technical decisions, and write them down so the wider team can build on them
* Work with product and design to turn real underwriter workflows into clear, accessible interfaces
* Apply secure development practice as a normal part of the job, in line with our certifications

**What we’re looking for**

* 3 to 6 years of professional software engineering, with production full-stack experience
* Strong Python and TypeScript, with React or a comparable frontend framework
* Experience building data or document processing pipelines that handle messy, real-world inputs
* Good architectural judgement: you can explain trade-offs in performance, cost, maintainability and reliability, and you simplify rather than over-engineer
* Hands-on cloud experience on AWS or GCP, including containers (ECS or Kubernetes), queues or messaging, and infrastructure as code
* Solid grounding in APIs, data modelling, and both SQL and NoSQL stores
* A track record of owning services in production: debugging, observability, incident response
* A self-starter mindset: you take a problem from vague to shipped without close supervision
* Clear written communication; you will be working across time zones with a UK and US team

**Useful, not required**

* Experience with LLM applications, vector search or OpenSearch, OCR or document AI tooling
* Exposure to Bedrock, Pub/Sub, Firestore or similar services
* Insurance or related financial services background. Not needed; we will teach the domain.

**What we offer**

* Direct work on a product with live London Market and US customers
* A small team where engineers have real ownership and influence on design
* Competitive Compensation

**How to apply**

Send your CV and a short note on something you have built and run in production to shravan@genairate.io.

title: Senior SDET – Automation Framework Architect (Playwright, Selenium, API, CI/CD)
description:
Senior SDET – Automation Framework Architect (Playwright, Selenium, API, CI/CD)THE ROLE

Own test strategy, quality architecture, and the automated regression infrastructure for Securly Flex — the flex period scheduling and attendance platform that 1,000+ schools use every school day to place students into intervention, enrichment, and support sessions.

**Flex decides where students are supposed to be.**
A defect in Autoassign placement, capacity limits, separation rules, roster sync, or attendance recording does not just break a feature — it can put a student in the wrong room, leave a must-attend intervention empty, place students together who are required to be kept apart, or send inaccurate attendance into a district's student information system. The test infrastructure you build is the last line of defense before production.

**This is an engineering leadership role, not a QA role.**
You will define what "production-ready" means for Flex, build the automation platform that enforces it through CI/CD quality gates, and write production-quality code for that platform yourself. You will also serve as the team's expert on rules-engine correctness and edge-case testing — your understanding of how Flex's rules interact (priorities, capacity limits, restricted sessions, sign-up cutoffs, and check-in controls) directly shapes both the test suite and the implementation team's design decisions.

**Location:**
Pune, India (Hybrid – 2 days onsite)
  
**Experience:**
6–10+ years
  
**Reports to:**
Director of Quality Engineering

WHAT YOU'LL DO

* ****Own the quality bar.****
  Define what "passing" means for Flex: establish written quality criteria covering scheduling correctness, data integrity, access control, and performance that gate production releases.
* ****Test the rules engine.****
  Design and implement automated test suites covering Autoassign placement logic — student choice, teacher priority, must-attend assignments, rostered and restricted sessions, at-risk designations, seat and room capacity, separation (contact control) rules, conflict detection, and the guarantee that manual registrations are never overwritten — plus the edge cases around them: conflicting rules, boundary conditions, concurrent registrations at capacity limits and sign-up cutoffs, API calls that skip UI validation, and permission boundaries.
* ****Gate every release.****
  Build CI/CD quality gates that prevent regressions from reaching production; own the pipeline configuration and ensure the quality bar is enforced, not advisory.
* ****Set performance baselines.****
  Measure and establish written performance baselines for peak-load moments: sign-up windows opening and closing, Autoassign runs before each flex period, and attendance taking across thousands of concurrent users; define the thresholds that constitute a performance regression.
* ****Cover web, mobile, and integrations.****
  Own end-to-end coverage across web, mobile, and integrations: student, teacher, and admin workflows; the student mobile app; email, in-product, and push notifications; roster imports and attendance exports to the SIS; and the shared rostering and single sign-on Flex runs on with Securly Pass.
* ****Build the framework.****
  Architect and build the Flex automation framework: reusable libraries, test data utilities for roster and attendance files, parallel execution, and reporting that the whole team extends — and contribute fixes to product code where it improves testability.
* ****Mentor and scale.****
  Mentor engineers on test architecture as a first-class discipline, and bring AI-assisted tooling into how the team generates scenarios, triages failures, and scales coverage.
* ****Shape architecture.****
  Partner with your technical lead and the Distinguished Engineer on architecture and testability decisions, and influence testing standards across teams beyond your own squad.
* ****Own incidents.****
  Join the on-call rotation and own the full incident lifecycle for quality regressions: detection, diagnosis, resolution, and retrospective.

SKILLS & REQUIREMENTSMust-Have

* ****Test framework architecture****
  — designing automation frameworks from scratch (page object or screenplay patterns, BDD where it fits, parallel execution, reporting) that other engineers extend. You build the platform, not just the scripts.
* ****Test automation (SDET-level)****
  — Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium for UI plus API-level automation (REST, contract testing). Must automate business-rule behavior — placement decisions, capacity and eligibility rules, state transitions — not just UI interaction tests.
* ****CI/CD quality gates****
  — integrating test suites into pipelines; defining and enforcing regression gates for a multi-tenant product used daily by 1,000+ schools. At this level you own the definition of the bar, not just the tests that check it.
* ****Rules-engine and data-integrity testing****
  — designing deterministic test data and fixtures for scheduling, allocation, or eligibility logic; building data utilities that validate rosters, registrations, and attendance across CSV/XML imports, exports, and concurrent edits.
* ****Strong programming****
  — JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Python at production quality (TypeScript strongly preferred). Your test code is held to the same review standard as product code.
* ****Technical communication****
  — ability to produce written quality criteria, test strategy and edge-case documentation, and performance baseline documents that the implementation team, engineering manager, PM, Support, and leadership can act on.
* ****Education & experience****
  — Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, with 6 to 10+ years of hands-on SDET / test automation experience.

Strongly Preferred

* ****Performance & concurrency testing****
  — k6, JMeter, Gatling, or Locust; modeling burst traffic (thousands of users acting in the same minute) and catching race conditions at capacity limits and sign-up cutoffs.
* ****AI-assisted test engineering****
  — using AI tools to generate test scenarios, triage failures, or scale framework adoption across teams.
* ****Security & access-control testing****
  — role-based permissions (student / teacher / admin), multi-tenant data isolation between districts, and student data privacy expectations.

Nice to Have

* ****Mobile test automation****
  — Appium, Maestro, Detox, or similar for iOS and Android; push notification and device-fragmentation coverage.
* ****Integration testing****
  — SIS data import/export, rostering sync, single sign-on, and notification delivery (email, in-product, push).
* ****K-12 EdTech domain****
  — understanding of bell schedules, flex and advisory periods, MTSS intervention tiers, and how districts manage SIS data helps design realistic test scenarios.

WHO YOU ARE

* ****You test the edge cases, not just the happy path.****
  You test the ways the system should fail and doesn't, and you document those cases so the implementation team designs against them.
* ****You have built automation frameworks from the ground up — not just inherited them — and other engineers have built on what you designed.****
* ****You treat test architecture as a first-class engineering discipline.****
  A feature without a regression suite is not finished — and you enforce that standard through CI/CD gates, not just code review comments.
* ****You define what "quality" means on a product that decides where students are supposed to be, and produce written criteria that hold the codebase to that standard across every engineer and every release.****
* ****You are hands-on at a senior level****
  — you still write the framework code, and you raise the bar for everyone who writes tests after you.
  **Experience shipping product feature code is a bonus, not a requirement.**
* ****Your edge-case documentation and performance baselines are used by the implementation team to make better architecture decisions.****
  Your influence extends past your own work.
* ****You own your area end to end with minimal oversight, and you resolve ambiguity in requirements and design tradeoffs instead of waiting for a fully formed spec.****

ABOUT SECURLY

**Tech Giant Scale. EdTech Innovation. Unmatched Student Impact.**

Securly processes over 1.1 billion requests per day and 54 TB of data daily, protecting more than 20 million students across 20,000+ schools globally. Since pioneering the first cloud-based web filter for K–12 in 2013, Securly has built one of the most trusted, high-scale platforms for student safety, wellness, and engagement.

By turning data into meaningful, actionable intelligence, Securly enables schools to identify risk earlier, reduce harmful incidents, and strengthen student support — driving measurable improvements in student safety and wellbeing at scale.

We are proud to be consistently recognized as a Top Place to Work, named a Top 40 Most Used EdTech platform, and included on the GSV 150 list as one of the most transformational growth companies in digital learning and workforce skills.

BENEFITS

* Comprehensive Health Insurance (employee, parents, spouse, children)
* Accidental & Term Life Insurance
* Learning & Development reimbursement
* Paid Time Off
* Public Holidays (10+ per year)
* Retirement Benefits (EPF & gratuity)
* Parental Leave (as per statutory norms)

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Securly is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to inclusion, fairness, and respect. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

title: Financial Systems Architect - OneStream
description:
**Job Title**
Financial Systems Architect - OneStream
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
**Job Description**
The
**Financial Systems Architect**
is a key member of the
**Technology and Data Solutions (TDS)**
team, responsible for supporting and enhancing Cushman & Wakefield's OneStream SaaS platform. This role focuses on ensuring security, governance, stability, and continuous improvement of enterprise financial processes, including financial consolidation, close, reporting, forecasting, planning, and analysis (xP&A).
  
  
Working closely with Product Managers, Finance leaders, business stakeholders, and cross-functional technology teams, the Senior Financial Systems Engineer designs, develops, and implements scalable solutions that improve automation, data quality, reporting capabilities, and financial decision-making. Serving as both a technical expert and strategic business partner, this individual translates business requirements into sustainable OneStream solutions through application configuration, business rules, integrations, and platform enhancements.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Finance, Accounting, FP&A, Master Data Management, and IT stakeholders to identify opportunities for process improvement and automation.
* Drive the delivery of scalable solutions that align with strategic business objectives and enterprise finance transformation initiatives.
* Collaborate with Product Managers and business users to define requirements, prioritize enhancements, and support roadmap execution.

**Application Configuration & Governance**

* Configure and maintain OneStream metadata, business rules, workflows, dashboards, reporting objects, and application settings.
* Ensure adherence to governance standards, development best practices, and change management processes.
* Support platform upgrades, releases, and ongoing optimization initiatives.

**Financial Close & Reporting Support**

* Provide system support during monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close cycles.
* Participate in consolidation processes, workflow execution, reporting deliverables, and issue resolution to ensure timely and accurate financial results.
* Partner with Finance teams to identify and resolve data, process, and report discrepancies.

**Platform Ownership & Administration**

* Administer and maintain OneStream environments, including Development, Test/Pre-Production, and Production.
* Monitor system performance, availability, and operational health while proactively identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Coordinate deployments and migration activities across environments.

**Security, Controls & Compliance**

* Support management of application security, role-based access controls, segregation of duties, and user provisioning processes.
* Perform periodic access reviews and support internal and external audit activities.

**The Role**
We're seeking a Product Owner , AI, Agentic Capabilities & Customer Experience to define and execute the strategy for bringing advanced and proactive AI capabilities, including Agentic AI, to the Lumen Customer Portal and enterprise digital experiences. This critical role is about building the next generation of digital service, moving the customer experience from interaction-first to resolution-first, by leveraging AI and autonomous (agentic) capabilities to solve complex B2B customer issues end-to-end and drive significant operational efficiency. This individual will own the Generative AI and Agentic Roadmap and its required foundational platform components, ensuring seamless integration into the enterprise customer portal, developer portal, and underlying API products. The individual in this role collaborates closely with cross-functional teams to drive development and integration, establish and maintain alignment between the customer experience and development roadmaps, and serve as a champion for safe, reliable, and high-quality autonomous experiences.
  
  
**The Main Responsibilities**

* Architecting the AI Future: Work collaboratively and cross-functionally to define the vision for the Lumen Platform's Generative AI strategy, specifically focusing on how Large Language Models (LLMs) and autonomous/agentic systems can resolve complex B2B customer issues end-to-end, aligned with organizational goals and strategic priorities.
* Bridging Technical & Business Needs: Translate complex B2B customer journeys and business requirements (e.g., ticket creation, service modification, billing inquiries) into clear, actionable technical specifications for AI Agents, conversational interfaces, and workflow automation systems and their required underlying Tooling/APIs and orchestration logic.
* Deep Customer & AI Feedback Engagement: Engage regularly with customers and platform users to capture real-world feedback on AI accuracy, trust, and usability. Leverage these insights to inform the Agentic AI continuous learning and refinement roadmap, ensuring high user satisfaction (CSAT/NPS).
* Championing the AI Tooling Layer: Advocate for and drive an API-first strategy to ensure the platform provides a robust, governed, and structured Tooling Layer that AI models and autonomous agents can reliably call for action (e.g., defining API standards, taxonomy, and latency requirements for AI consumption).
* Driving AI Execution & Governance: Lead execution of the Generative AI and Agentic roadmap, defining detailed capabilities, LLM integration requirements, and Guardrails & Safety protocols (including Prompt Injection Prevention, data masking, and compliance checks) to mitigate risks like hallucination and data leakage.
* AI Performance & Lifecycle Management: Implement rigorous AI Governance and MLOps practices. Define and track key performance indicators including Task Success Rate, Hallucination Rate, Cost Per Interaction (CPI), and Agent Latency, ensuring solutions are robust, and changes are vetted against these metrics before release. Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve the end-to-end roadmap execution process, driving key learnings back into the organization.

**What We Look For In a Candidate**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education and experience in a relevant technical discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering); master's degree is a plus.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in Technical Product Management or Software Engineering, including 3+ years directly defining and launching Generative AI capabilities (specifically Agentic AI, large-scale conversational interfaces, or autonomous workflows).
* Deep expertise in Generative AI architectures, Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns, and the design of AI 'tools' or functions for autonomous agents.
* Deep technical knowledge and understanding of API design principles (REST, GraphQL, Event Driven APIs), microservices architecture, and cloud platforms.
* Extensive experience with digital platforms, enterprise customer portals, and/or complex web applications, coupled with strong working knowledge of user experience design & research, and modern software development methodologies (Agile, DevOps).
* Proven ability to analyze complex technical data, identify and troubleshoot intricate technical issues, and develop scalable solutions that directly impact the customer and developer experience on the platform.
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills that enable effective collaboration with diverse technical and non-technical teams, stakeholders, and customers. Ability to create clarity and drive focus in complex and dynamic technical contexts up, down, and across the organization.
* Ability to manage and lead multiple technical priorities and projects while delivering against tight timelines in a complex and dynamic environment.
